topic: Trade show booths, banners and check-in desks
summary: A standard inline exhibit is 10 x 10 ft (3.05 x 3.05 m) with an 8 ft (2.44 m) high back wall and low (about 3 ft) side rails; show floors are laid out in 10 ft increments. It holds one counter or 6 ft table (a typical counter is 48 in wide by 36 in high, 1.22 x 0.91 m), two or three visitors and a 32 to 55 in monitor on the wall; keep items in the front half of the booth under about 4 ft and leave the front 2 to 3 ft as aisle. Exhibitor kits set height limits, so check the show manual. A retractable banner stand and a branded check-in desk follow the same rules; the usual retractable banner is about 33 x 80 in (0.84 x 2.03 m), and the check-in desk reuses the 48 in counter size. Those two sizes are typical, not confirmed on a product page, so confidence is lower.
